gates.evidence: The offer appears on the Janitor Plus paywall (s03), which is an SFW surface.
Reward is for game play; no mention of incentivizing clicks or installs.
Offer is a positive sampling of premium features with no threats.
The user must tap 'Play to try' to initiate the experience.
States 15s game and 10 minutes of reward.
The proposal explicitly provides no decline option ('decline': '') in the offer definition, violating [POL-2 #5].
Triggered on the paywall screen s03, not during an active chat.
Proposal explicitly restricts eligibility to non-payers only.

scores.evidence: Perfect moment: the user just saw the paywall and the value proposition (memory/speed) and declined, so we offer a sample of that exact value.
The offer is an additive sample of a premium entitlement; it respects the user's flow.
Highly restricted: limited to 1 per day, decliners only, and time-boxed.
Cost-to-serve ($0.0018) is significantly lower than revenue (~$0.012+), making this highly profitable.
Limited to users hitting the paywall; while high-intent, this is a lower volume than a core-loop surface.
Uses standard SIM-RWD units and targets an existing paywall screen.
Uses the specific Janitor Plus branding '5x context for better memory'.
Capped at 1 per day, which is very conservative.
Includes a 10% holdout, KPI tracking, and guardrail metrics.

requiredChanges: Add a visible decline button (e.g., 'No thanks') to the offer card.
Ensure the decline action simply dismisses the offer card without penalty and allows the user to continue usage of the paywall screen.
parsed.topConcern: The proposal lacks a decline option, which is a mandatory requirement under AdMob and Unity policies to ensure the ad experience is strictly voluntary and does not interfere with app usage.
